en_title: Fable Reveals First Look At Bowerstone's New Map, And It's Huge
cn_title: 《神鬼寓言》首次展示Bowerstone新地图，规模十分庞大
opus_summary: XBOX发布的数字杂志首次展示了新《神鬼寓言》中Bowerstone的完整地图，这座城市将分为三个区域。游戏总监Ralph Fulton表示，团队为新作完全重建了Bowerstone，没有沿用前作的地图或大致位置。游戏延期后定于2027年2月23日发售。

paragraphs.en: Over the weekend, Xbox released a digital magazine featuring details on upcoming games. One of the games featured heavily is the long-awaited Fable revival, set to launch next February after numerous delays .
paragraphs.cn: 上周末，XBOX发布了一本数字杂志，介绍了即将推出的游戏的详细信息。其中着重介绍的游戏之一，是备受期待的《神鬼寓言》系列新作。经过多次延期后，该作定于明年2月发售。

paragraphs.en: In a six-page spread, the magazine gives us a bunch of new details about Fable, including some returning features and new quests. However, the big pull here is that it finally reveals the full scope of the capital city, Bowerstone, showing us exactly how it will look 16 years after we last saw it in Fable 3.
paragraphs.cn: 杂志用六页篇幅介绍了《神鬼寓言》的大量新细节，包括一些回归的特色内容和新任务。不过，这里的最大看点是，它终于揭示了首都Bowerstone的全貌，让我们看到了这座城市在我们上次于《神鬼寓言3》中见到它16年后的具体模样。

paragraphs.en: As we can see on the map, Bowerstone will be split into three districts in the new Fable. Those districts are:
paragraphs.cn: 从地图上可以看到，在新的《神鬼寓言》中，Bowerstone将分为三个区域。这些区域分别是：

paragraphs.en: On top of this, familiar landmarks can be found in these districts:
paragraphs.cn: 此外，这些区域中还可以找到一些熟悉的地标：

paragraphs.en: From this, we can see that Playground Games has mashed all the different Bowerstones in the original Fable trilogy together. We have the whimsy of the first game with the Heroes' Guild being attached to the city, the budding aristocracy of the second game with upper-class areas like Bowerminster, and an underclass in Copperbottom, as we saw in Fable 3.
paragraphs.cn: 由此可以看出，Playground Games将《神鬼寓言》原版三部曲中各不相同的Bowerstone融合到了一起。这里有初代游戏中英雄公会与城市相连所体现的奇幻想象，也有第二部游戏中以Bowerminster等上层阶级区域为代表的新兴贵族阶层，还有如同《神鬼寓言3》中所见的Copperbottom底层阶级。

paragraphs.en: Many of these landmarks will also be familiar. Fairfax Castle was a major area in Fable 2, as it's where the player is taken at the beginning of the game and introduced to the antagonist, Lucien. That becomes Bowerstone Castle in Fable 3, which is where the player is raised. Here, Playground says Fairfax has "never been this grand", and will be a constant looming presence as we explore Bowerstone.
paragraphs.cn: 这些地标中有许多也会让人感到熟悉。Fairfax Castle是《神鬼寓言2》中的一个重要区域，玩家在游戏开始时被带到那里，并与反派Lucien相识。在《神鬼寓言3》中，它变成了Bowerstone Castle，玩家角色在此长大。Playground表示，这次的Fairfax「从未如此宏伟」，在我们探索Bowerstone时，它将始终高耸于视野之中。

paragraphs.en: Despite these similarities, game director Ralph Fulton admits that changes have been made wherever they have been needed.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管存在这些相似之处，游戏总监Ralph Fulton承认，他们在所有有需要的地方都做出了改动。

paragraphs.en: "The map of Albion — the literal landmass — has changed from game to game," Fulton says in the Xbox magazine. "In folklore, details are always what's remembered and therefore subject to memories and flowery recollections and retellings. So we always gave ourselves permission to rethink and reimagine aspects of the original trilogy. That means we rebuilt Bowerstone completely for our game. We didn't follow maps or even general locations from the previous games. We built Bowerstone to serve the needs of our Fable."
paragraphs.cn: 「Albion的地图——字面意义上的陆地范围——在每部游戏中都有变化，」Fulton在XBOX杂志中说，「在民间传说中，人们记住的总是细节，因此这些细节会受到记忆、添油加醋的回忆和转述的影响。所以我们始终允许自己重新思考和构想原版三部曲中的各个方面。这意味着我们为自己的游戏彻底重建了Bowerstone。我们没有沿用前作的地图，甚至没有沿用大致的地点布局。我们打造Bowerstone是为了满足我们这款《神鬼寓言》的需求。」

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in the magazine feature, we're told that we're getting a version of that quest in Fable 2 and 3 that had us go after gargoyles/gnomes that hurl insults at us whenever we walk past them. This time, we have to track down "fairy flowers". We'll be able to tell when we're near one because we'll overhear fairies who have gotten drunk off its nectar, hopefully throwing creative jabs at us like their predecessors.
paragraphs.cn: 杂志专题的其他部分还提到，《神鬼寓言2》和《神鬼寓言3》中的那个任务将以另一种形式回归：在原任务中，我们要去寻找每当我们走过就会辱骂我们的石像鬼／侏儒。这一次，我们要寻找「仙女花」。当我们靠近其中一朵时，就能听到喝了花蜜而醉酒的仙女的声音；希望她们会像前辈们一样，用富有创意的话语挖苦我们。

paragraphs.en: It won't be long until we're diving into Playground's take on the Fable setting for ourselves. Following a delay from October, it's now set to launch on February 23, 2027. If you want more Fable, Xbox dropped new gameplay footage last week .
paragraphs.cn: 再过不久，我们就能亲自体验Playground诠释下的《神鬼寓言》世界。该作从原定的10月延期后，现在定于2027年2月23日发售。如果你想了解更多《神鬼寓言》的消息，XBOX上周公布了新的实机画面。
